## <A section with tabs> {#chapter-id-tabs .tabset}

Tabs are good for parallel material — the same task in R and in Python, or a
set of alternatives the reader picks between. They are bad for sequential
material, because only one pane is visible at a time.

### R {.unlisted .unnumbered}

```r
# Illustrative only — chunks are not executed at build time.
library(here)
dat <- read.csv(here("data", "raw", "example.csv"))
```

### Python {.unlisted .unnumbered}

```python
from pyprojroot import here
import pandas as pd

dat = pd.read_csv(here("data/raw/example.csv"))
```
